text:
Both Assistant A and Assistant B provided correct evaluations of the movie reviews in their first responses. However, when asked to update their previous replies by including the release date as part of the JSON content, Assistant B followed the user's instructions more accurately by providing a JSON array of objects with "rating" and "release_date" keys. Assistant A, on the other hand, included the entire review text in the JSON array, which was not requested by the user. Therefore, Assistant B provided a better answer to the second user question.

My final verdict is: [[B]]
